license_required.quote: practices nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse unless licensed to do so under this chapter or IC 25-42

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Indiana state board of nursing.

name.quote: There is established the Indiana state board of nursing

type.quote: There is established the Indiana state board of nursing consisting of eleven (11) members appointed by the governor

umbrella_agency.quote: The account shall be administered by the Indiana professional licensing agency.

moral_character_required.quote: not have: (A) been convicted of a crime that has a direct bearing on the person's ability to practice competently; or (B) committed an act that would constitute a ground for a disciplinary sanction under IC 25-1-9

degree_required.value: state accredited program of registered nursing (or practical nursing)
degree_required.quote: have completed: (A) the prescribed curriculum and met the graduation requirements of a state accredited program of registered nursing

accrediting_body.quote: Accredit such programs as meet the requirements of this chapter and of the board.

exams.name: National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX)
exams.notes: Required for both RN and LPN licensure; also required for foreign graduates
exams.quote: The applicant must pass an examination in such subjects as the board may determine.

interval_years.quote: a license to practice as a registered nurse expires on October 31 in each odd-numbered year

required.quote: Require, as a condition of the renewal of the authority, the completion by the advanced practice registered nurse of the continuing education requirements set out in section 19.7 of this chapter.

hours_per_period.quote: the applicant has successfully completed at least thirty (30) contact hours of continuing education

period_years.quote: be completed within the two (2) years immediately preceding the renewal

value: pharmacology (at least 8 contact hours for prescriptive authority renewal)
topical_requirements.quote: include at least eight (8) contact hours of pharmacology

available.quote: The board may issue by endorsement a license to practice as a registered nurse to an applicant who has been licensed as a registered nurse, by examination, under the laws of another state

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current license in another state and possess credentials and qualifications substantially equivalent to Indiana requirements for licensure by examination.
requirements.quote: the applicant holds a current license in another state and possesses credentials and qualifications that are substantially equivalent to requirements in Indiana for licensure by examination

regulatory_model.quote: practices nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse unless licensed to do so under this chapter or IC 25-42

credential_type.quote: Any person who applies to the board for a license to practice as a registered nurse

is_mandatory.quote: practices nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse unless licensed to do so under this chapter or IC 25-42; commits a Class B misdemeanor.

title_protection.quote: No other person shall practice or advertise as or assume the title of registered nurse or use the abbreviation of "R.N." or any other words, letters, signs, or figures to indicate that the person using same is a registered nurse.

scope_protection.quote: practices nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse unless licensed to do so under this chapter or IC 25-42

disciplinary_grounds.description: Selling, fraudulently obtaining, or furnishing any nursing diploma, license, or record
disciplinary_grounds.quote: sells or fraudulently obtains or furnishes any nursing diploma, license or record

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing under cover of a diploma or license illegally or fraudulently obtained
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practices nursing under cover of any diploma or license or record illegally or fraudulently obtained or assigned or issued unlawfully or under fraudulent representation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practices nursing as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse unless licensed to do so under this chapter or IC 25-42

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a designation implying licensure as a registered nurse or licensed practical nurse without a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: uses in connection with the person's name any designation tending to imply that the person is a registered nurse or a licensed practical nurse unless licensed to practice under this chapter or IC 25-42

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing nursing while the license is suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practices nursing during the time the person's license issued under this chapter or IC 25-42 is suspended or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting a school of nursing or practical nurse training program without board accreditation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conducts a school of nursing or a program for the training of practical nurses unless the school or program has been accredited by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by an APRN to comply with audit requirements or the requirements of a practice agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with: (1) an audit conducted under this section; or (2) the requirements of a practice agreement under this chapter.

definition_quote.value: registered nursing means performance of services which include but are not limited to: (1) assessing health conditions; (2) deriving a nursing diagnosis; (3) executing a nursing regimen through the selection, performance, and management of nursing actions based on nursing diagnoses; (4) advocating the provision of health care services through collaboration with or referral to other health professionals; (5) executing regimens delegated by a physician with an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine, a licensed dentist, a licensed chiropractor, a licensed optometrist, or a licensed podiatrist; (6) teaching, administering, supervising, delegating, and evaluating nursing practice; (7) delegating tasks which assist in implementing the nursing, medical, or dental regimen; or (8) performing acts which are approved by the board or by the board in collaboration with the medical licensing board of Indiana.
definition_quote.quote: "registered nursing" means performance of services which include but are not limited to: (1) assessing health conditions; (2) deriving a nursing diagnosis; (3) executing a nursing regimen through the selection, performance, and management of nursing actions based on nursing diagnoses

value: advocating provision of health care services through collaboration or referral
teaching, administering, supervising, delegating, and evaluating nursing practice

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice registered nurses (excluding CRNAs) may be authorized to prescribe drugs including controlled substances upon meeting board requirements; CRNAs may administer anesthesia under direction and immediate presence of a physician without separate prescriptive authority.
drug_authority.quote: The board shall establish a program under which advanced practice registered nurses who meet the requirements established by the board are authorized to prescribe drugs, including controlled substances

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - including Nurse Practitioner, Certified Nurse Midwife, Clinical Nurse Specialist, Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
license_tiers.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means: (1) a nurse practitioner; (2) a certified nurse midwife; (3) a clinical nurse specialist; or (4) a certified registered nurse anesthetist

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" means: (1) a nurse practitioner; (2) a certified nurse midwife; (3) a clinical nurse specialist; or (4) a certified registered nurse anesthetist

value: physician with an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: "licensed practical nurse" means a person who holds a valid license issued under this chapter or IC 25-42 and who functions at the direction of: (1) a registered nurse; (2) a physician with an unlimited license to practice medicine or osteopathic medicine; (3) a licensed dentist; (4) a licensed chiropractor; (5) a licensed optometrist; or (6) a licensed podiatrist

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall operate: (1) in collaboration with a licensed practitioner as evidenced by a practice agreement

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse shall operate: (1) in collaboration with a licensed practitioner as evidenced by a practice agreement

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The board shall establish a program under which advanced practice registered nurses who meet the requirements established by the board are authorized to prescribe drugs

value: controlled substances as defined in IC 35-48-1-9 (all schedules, subject to board rules)
controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: authorized to prescribe drugs, including controlled substances (as defined in IC 35-48-1.1-7) in accordance with IC 25-1-9.3

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: "INSPECT program" means the Indiana scheduled prescription electronic collection and tracking program established by IC 25-1-13-4

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: performance of tasks by persons who provide health care services which are delegated or ordered by licensed health professionals, if the delegated or ordered tasks do not exceed the scope of practice of the licensed health professionals under Indiana law

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The nurse licensure compact is enacted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: if the applicant is applying for a multistate license (as defined in IC 25-42-1-11) under IC 25-42 (Nurse Licensure Compact), a fee of twenty-five dollars ($25) in addition to the fee under subdivision (1)

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The board shall assist in the rehabilitation of an impaired registered nurse or licensed practical nurse.

crna_physician_supervision_model.quote: A certified registered nurse anesthetist may administer anesthesia if the certified registered nurse anesthetist acts under the direction of and in the immediate presence of a physician.
